resources.string: Returning from background keeps the ground visible, without a brief sky-only flash.
Orbits and object markers remain visible while the compass reacquires fresh readings.
The star background retains its last frame while paused, without background calculations.
Orientation-loading notices appear only when the main view is active in the foreground.
Object-selection arrows are optically centred, with smaller and properly aligned press feedback.
The screensaver now shows “Tap to return to the app” at the top.
